newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BMW Asian sales rise 33 up pct in 1Q.
newsitem.headline: BMW Asian sales rise 33 up pct in 1Q.

text.p: Germany luxury carmaker Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) said on Friday sales of its cars in Southeast Asia rose by some 33 percent in the first quarter of 1997 against the first quarter of 1996.
A BMW Asia statement said the rise was achieved against a background of falling registrations in the luxury car segment in the region.
BMW's six major markets of Taiwan, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong bought nearly 6,000 units in the first quarter against 4,500 units in the previous three months.
Sales in Taiwan, where BMW is the top selling luxury car, rose by a hefty 82 percent to 1,734 units.
Singapore and Indonesia also chalked up strong increases of 85 percent each during the quarter.
However sales in Hong Kong and Thailand fell during the quarter, the company said.
